metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the CLI in [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py) and added the `ical` launcher at [output/ical](/workspace/output/ical). It parses the requested component schemas and expands Gregorian recurrence rules, period-valued RDATEs, overrides, and file-defined timezones. `python -m py_compile output/main.py` succeeds.

This is not yet a complete implementation of the requested RFC behavior: non-Gregorian `RSCALE` expansion and `TZUNTIL`-bounded timezone handling remain unsupported. I also did not verify runtime behavior against real partner calendars.
